description: Defines the SerialWorker class for serial execution of background jobs on ThreadPool, including nested WorkItem class, retry/backoff logic, and thread safety mechanisms.

classes.name: SerialWorker
classes.description: Manages serial execution of work items on ThreadPool with retry/backoff support.

classes.name: SerialWorker::WorkItem
classes.description: Abstract class representing a unit of work to be executed on a worker thread, with follow-up work capability.

methods.name: SerialWorker::SerialWorker
methods.description: Constructor initializing retry limits and backoff policy.

methods.name: SerialWorker::WorkNow
methods.description: Posts work to ThreadPool if not already scheduled.

methods.name: SerialWorker::IsCancelled
methods.description: Checks if the worker has been cancelled.

methods.name: SerialWorker::GetBackoffEntryForTesting
methods.description: Returns current backoff state for testing.

methods.name: SerialWorker::CreateWorkItem
methods.description: Pure virtual; creates a new work item.

methods.name: SerialWorker::OnWorkFinished
methods.description: Pure virtual; called after work item completes, to process results.

methods.name: SerialWorker::AsWeakPtr
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the SerialWorker instance.

methods.name: SerialWorker::WorkNowInternal
methods.description: Internal method to handle scheduling work.

methods.name: SerialWorker::OnDoWorkFinished
methods.description: Handles completion of DoWork on origin thread.

methods.name: SerialWorker::OnFollowupWorkFinished
methods.description: Handles completion of follow-up work on origin thread.

methods.name: SerialWorker::RerunWork
methods.description: Re-schedules work after failure or retry.
